title: Workflow: bootstrap path for first run of a new update (U50 activation failure)
description:
The Generate-builds workflow had no bootstrap path for the FIRST run of a brand-new update, so activating U50 failed immediately. Two root causes:

1. 'Download existing builds.json' used 'curl -s' WITHOUT --fail. GitHub Pages serves its 404 page as HTTP 404 but with an HTML BODY; curl wrote that HTML into builds.json and exited 0, so download_success=true (falsely). The validate step then choked parsing HTML as JSON and the job failed (run 27885437551).

2. Even with --fail, a new update has no prior builds.json on the live site or in the repo, and 'Attempt restore from artifacts' would pull the LAST successful run's artifact — which is the PREVIOUS update's data (U49) — contaminating U50.

Fix (generate-builds.yml):
- Added 'Bootstrap new update' step: is_new_update=true only when (no builds.json committed in repo for the prefix) AND (live site returns a definitive 404). It seeds output/<prefix>/builds.json = {"trials": {}, "last_full_update": null} and the scan populates from scratch. After the first deploy the live URL returns 200, so later runs (different trials) are treated as established and download accumulated data — preventing data loss. Ambiguous live status (timeout/5xx/000) is treated as established so a transient outage can never wipe an update.
- Gated Download/Validate/Restore/both Fail steps to skip when is_new_update==true.
- Added --fail (curl -fsS) to both download curls so a 404 HTML page is never mistaken for valid data (also fixes transient-404 handling for established updates).
acceptance_criteria: 1. A manual U50 run (workflow_dispatch, trial_id=1) completes successfully and deploys output/u50/. 2. /u50/ and /u50/builds.json return 200 on live with 1 trial after first run. 3. A second U50 run (different trial) preserves the first trial (data accumulates, not wiped). 4. Established u49 runs unaffected. 5. Archived u48/u49 still served.
notes: Detection signal verified locally: u49→established (committed), u50→new (no repo copy + live 404). This bug would recur for every future update activation (u51, u52, ...); the fix is generic. Related: U50 activation (eso-build-o-rama-691).
close_reason: Fixed and verified live: U50 first run bootstrapped empty (live 404→seed), run 2 detected established (live 200→download) and accumulated. /u50/ live, root redirects, u48/u49 preserved. Runs 27885609031 + 27885715114.

title: Log missing ability/gear icons during scan so they can be sourced
description:
The committed icon set (static/icons/, ~1667 files, no auto-download) goes stale when ESO renames or adds ability icons. When an icon referenced by a generated page is absent, the ability still renders (alt text shows the name), so it is not a blocking error — but there is currently no visibility into WHICH icons are missing. The tool should detect and log every missing icon filename during a scan/generation run so the missing files can be sourced and added manually.

Concrete example found during U50 testing: ESO Logs API returns abilityIcon 'ability_dragonknight_013_stonefist_b.png' for Stone Giant, but the icon set only had the older 'ability_dragonknight_013_b.png'. This 404s on the live site for ~19 U49 pages and went undetected.

Requirements:
- During page generation (page_generator) or icon resolution, check whether each referenced ability/gear icon exists in static/icons/.
- Collect missing icon filenames (deduplicated) and emit a clear summary at the end of the run, e.g. 'WARNING: N missing icons: <list>'. Optionally also write them to a file (e.g. output/<update>/missing_icons.txt) for easy hand-off.
- Must NOT fail the build — missing icons are non-blocking as long as the ability still renders with alt text.
- Include the ability/set display name alongside the filename in the log to make sourcing easier.
acceptance_criteria: 1. A scan run logs a deduplicated list of every referenced icon filename not present in static/icons/. 2. Each entry includes the icon filename and the associated ability/set name. 3. The run still completes successfully (missing icons are non-blocking). 4. Verified against U50 data: if the Stone Giant alias is removed, the run reports it as missing.
notes: Related: deployment_check.py already has icon-existence validation (lines ~271-290) but it is silently skipped on pages where its ability-slot selector finds 'No ability slots found' — so it does not currently catch these. Consider fixing that selector as part of, or alongside, this work. Icon source location: static/icons/ (copied to output/static/icons at build time). Parent context: U50 transition (eso-build-o-rama-lgr).

title: Update GitHub Actions to Node 24-compatible action versions
description: The Generate ESO Builds workflow (.github/workflows/generate-builds.yml) uses actions running on Node.js 20, which GitHub deprecates. Node 20 actions are forced to Node 24 by default starting June 16 2026, and Node 20 is removed from runners Sept 16 2026. Affected actions: actions/checkout@v4, actions/setup-python@v4, actions/configure-pages@v4, actions/upload-artifact@v4, actions/deploy-pages@v4. Bump each to a version that supports Node 24 (e.g. checkout@v5, setup-python@v5, upload-artifact@v4 latest, configure-pages/deploy-pages latest) and verify a workflow run still succeeds.
design:
Node24-safe target versions (verified against GitHub release tags 2026-06-08):
- actions/checkout@v4 -> @v5  (v5+ runs node24; latest v6.0.3)
- actions/setup-python@v4 -> @v6  (CORRECTION: v5 is still node20; latest v6.2.0)
- actions/upload-artifact@v4 -> @v5  (CORRECTION: ALL v4 is node20; latest v7.0.1)
- actions/configure-pages@v4 -> @v6  (v6 is the node24 release)
- actions/upload-pages-artifact@v3 -> @v5  (MISSED IN ORIGINAL: composite action pinning a node20 upload-artifact; pairs with deploy-pages@v5)
- actions/deploy-pages@v4 -> @v5  (v5 is the node24 release)
setup-python@v6 and upload-artifact@v5+ require Actions Runner >= 2.327.1 (ubuntu-latest already satisfies this). python-version 3.9 remains supported by setup-python@v6.
acceptance_criteria: All 6 actions bumped to node24-safe versions; actionlint passes; a deploy_only run and a full trial run both complete with conclusion=success; live site integrity confirmed (deployment_check.py).
notes: Test strategy: workflow has no PR/push trigger and deploys to prod Pages, so no branch-safe CI. Graduated approach: (1) actionlint static check; (2) deploy_only=true dispatch exercises checkout+configure-pages+upload-pages-artifact+deploy-pages (always-run, near-zero blast radius, republishes committed output/); (3) normal trial dispatch (trial_id=1) exercises setup-python+upload-artifact (guarded by deploy_only != true), protected by existing download/validate/backup/restore steps. Verify with scripts/deployment_check.py + gh run view.
close_reason: All 6 actions on node24 (checkout@v5, setup-python@v6, upload-artifact@v7, configure-pages@v6, upload-pages-artifact@v5, deploy-pages@v5); deploy_only + full trial runs both green; no node20 deprecation warnings; live site 200. Also fixed latent invalid configure-pages static_site_generator:custom that v6 surfaced.

title: Trash Builds silently broken since f4b3019 (2026-04-04): None + str in _process_single_fight name check
description: ROOT CAUSE: trial_scanner._process_single_fight computes name_valid = (fight_name == expected or fight_name.startswith(expected + " /") or fight_name.endswith("/ " + expected)) BEFORE the `if expected_encounter_name and not name_valid` guard. Trash fights deliberately pass expected_encounter_name=None, so `None + " /"` raises TypeError, caught per fight and logged as "Error processing trash fight N in report X: unsupported operand type(s) for +". EVIDENCE: CI logs for the last scheduled runs show Processed trash fight: 0 vs Error processing trash fight: 10-16 per run; live u50 builds.json contains 0 "Trash Builds" entries vs 34 in u49 (38 u49 trash pages on disk, 0 for u50). Introduced by f4b3019 which replaced the short-circuit `if expected and fight_name != expected`. FIX: make the check short-circuit, e.g. name_valid = expected_encounter_name is None or fight_name == expected_encounter_name or fight_name.startswith(expected_encounter_name + " /") or fight_name.endswith("/ " + expected_encounter_name); add a unit test that calls the validation with expected_encounter_name=None and with the "Boss / Boss" composite names. NOTE: after the fix, trash pages return gradually as each trial is rescanned over the 14-hour cycle.
acceptance_criteria: AA scan logs "Processed trash fight" with zero "Error processing trash fight"; builds.json gains Trash Builds entries; deployment check passes trash pages; unit test covers None and composite names.
close_reason: Fixed in a65b51a (_fight_name_matches short-circuits on None). Deploy run 37394072520: 0 trash errors, 9 Trash Builds for AA live at 00:28Z; 13 regression tests.

title: Role-fallback builds query mundus without a fight window -> "Mundus is Unknown" on tank/healer fallback pages
description: ROOT CAUSE: trial_scanner._create_fallback_build builds a CommonBuild with fight_id/report_code but never sets fight_start_time/fight_end_time (defaults 0). fetch_mundus_for_builds then calls api_client.get_player_buffs with start_time=0/end_time=0, which get_player_buffs converts with `int(x) if x is not None else None` so 0 is sent as a real window; ESO Logs rejects it: "You must either provide fightIDs, or provide startTime and endTime, or both". EVIDENCE: in the 2026-10-06 AA scan every "Failed to get buffs for <name>" character is exactly an "Added fallback tank/healer build: <name>" character (7 of 7, counts match); deployment_check then fails aetherian-archive-foundation-stone-atronach-earthen-soldier-... with "Mundus is Unknown or empty". FIX (both): (1) add fight_start_time/fight_end_time to TrialReport, set them in _process_single_fight next to fight_id, and pass them through in _create_fallback_build; (2) defensively in get_player_buffs treat 0 as absent (`int(start_time) if start_time else None`) so fightIDs alone is used. Add a unit test asserting fallback builds carry the fight window.
acceptance_criteria: No "Failed to get buffs" warnings for fallback builds in an AA scan; deployment_check no longer reports Mundus Unknown for the earthen-soldier Foundation Stone Atronach build.
close_reason: Fixed in a65b51a: TrialReport carries fight window into fallback builds, _window_ms sends 0 as absent, fight_i_ds kwarg so fightIDs are really sent. Deploy run 37394072520: 0 buff failures, AA empty-mundus builds 13 -> 0 live.

title: deployment_check.py / pre-merge-check.sh / docs do not understand the per-update output layout (output-dev/u50)
description: EVIDENCE: pointing deployment_check.py at output-dev (as CLAUDE.md, README and scripts/pre-merge-check.sh default do, and as the pre-push hook does) yields 3 errors: "Home page has no trials", "No trial pages found", "updates: Mundus field not found" because it reads <dir>/index.html and globs <dir>/*.html while pages now live in <dir>/<prefix>/. Pointing it at output-dev/u50 yields 11 passed / 1 failed (a real data issue). So the documented pre-merge gate cannot pass as written; still true after f3fee2b (checker still uses self.output_dir directly). FIX: in deployment_check.py resolve the current update prefix from data/update_config.json (or accept --update) and descend into <dir>/<prefix>/ when it exists; check the root router index/updates page separately; make pre-merge-check.sh pass the resolved dir; update CLAUDE.md/README command examples.
acceptance_criteria: `./scripts/pre-merge-check.sh output-dev` exits 0 on a good u50 build without the caller knowing the prefix.

title: Corrupted builds.json download fails the job instead of falling through to artifact restore
description: EVIDENCE: GitHub runs `run:` steps with bash -e. The "Validate downloaded builds.json" step executes `python3 << EOF ... EOF` as a plain statement and only afterwards reads $?; a simulation under bash --noprofile --norc -eo pipefail with corrupt JSON exits 1 and never writes is_valid, so the job fails there and the restore step (rewritten in f80bdc3) is only reachable when the download itself fails. Fail-closed, so no data loss, but no recovery either. FIX: wrap the heredoc as `if python3 - "$FILE" << EOF ... EOF; then echo is_valid=true else echo is_valid=false fi` (same pattern as the restore step) and pass the path via sys.argv instead of interpolating ${{ }} into Python.
acceptance_criteria: Simulation with corrupt JSON exits 0 and writes is_valid=false; a real run with a corrupt download reaches the restore step.

title: tests/exploration scripts are collected by pytest and fail on missing fixtures
description: EVIDENCE: tests/exploration/ holds 14 __main__ runner scripts whose helpers are named test_*(client, encounter_id, ...) so pytest treats the parameters as fixtures: bare `pytest` gives 10 failed / 7 errors ("fixture client not found"); one script imports eso_build_o_rama without the src. prefix so PYTHONPATH=src is also required. No pytest config exists. FIX: add pyproject.toml [tool.pytest.ini_options] with testpaths=["tests"], addopts="--ignore=tests/exploration", pythonpath=["src","."], and asyncio_mode="auto" if pytest-asyncio is to drive the async tests; or move the scripts to scripts/exploration/ and drop the test_ prefix from helpers. Then CI can run pytest as a gate.
acceptance_criteria: Bare `pytest` from the repo root passes with no env vars; exploration scripts still run via python <script>.

title: Partial skill-line detection: ~half of U50 AA builds show "Unknown" subclasses
description: EVIDENCE (live u50 builds.json, Aetherian Archive, 2026-10-06): 31 of 63 builds before deploy 2 and 32 of 63 non-trash builds after it have fewer than 3 detected skill lines, rendering as "Herald / Unknown / Unknown" on trial pages and "x" in slugs (37 "Unknown" cells on the live AA trial page vs 1 on the u49 page). Not caused by the trash/mundus fixes (pre-existing in the pre-fix snapshot). HYPOTHESES: (1) U50 added/renamed abilities that are missing from the ability->skill-line mapping in subclass_analyzer.py, so casts are not attributed; (2) role-fallback builds (count=1) and short fights have too few casts for the top-3 selection; (3) the "weight ultimates" heuristic drops lines with no ultimate cast. NEXT: dump the unattributed ability IDs/names for a few affected players from the cached casts tables and check them against the mapping; compare against a u49 snapshot of the same players to see whether this started with U50.
acceptance_criteria: Root cause identified with counts; if mapping gaps, mapping updated and AA shows <10% builds with Unknown lines after a rescan.
